clue.text: Deserter taking a job at one point

parts.note: a job or position is a post
taken as written
E, east, is one of the points of the compass

explanation.surface: A soldier who walked out has taken up a post at some lookout spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abandons a faith or cause is a renegade who has deserted it.

clue.text: A garden feature by a certain journal turned up

clue.text: Broadcast sport etc, involving a viewer

explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' rearranges SPORTETC into SPECTTOR; 'involving' puts A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who watches an event is an onlooker.

clue.text: Strike the tents and move off

clue.text: Get an assembly (about a half-dozen) to plan a course

explanation.definitionFit: To steer a ship or plot a route is to plan and follow a course.

clue.text: With nowhere to stow the luggage it's no use

clue.text: Current producer's function is to hold a lot of people back
